bullets.text: Ultimate College Bundle Launched - **Microsoft** offers students over $500 in value with new Windows 11 PCs and services.
AI Incident Response Insights - **Microsoft** outlines new challenges in incident response with AI's unpredictable outputs.
PostgreSQL App Development Boost - **Microsoft** introduces resources to enhance PostgreSQL integration across Azure platforms.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New builds released for **Windows Insiders** with enhancements and security features.
Forrester Recognizes Microsoft - **Microsoft** named a Leader in Sovereign Cloud Platforms, emphasizing digital sovereignty.
Agentic SOC Concept Introduced - **Microsoft** redefines security operations to proactively counter cyber threats with AI.
Storm-2755 Cyber Threat Analysis - **Microsoft** investigates a new financial threat targeting Canadian payroll systems.
Android SDK Vulnerability Discovered - **Microsoft** identifies a critical flaw in EngageSDK affecting millions of Android wallets.
